issues.where: the rectangular blocks sitting on the ledges, centre and centre-right
issues.what: clean box-shaped slabs with straight edges and flat faces read as placed primitives, not fallen rock, and show at normal speed
issues.fix: replace them with fractured, weathered blocks with broken edges and talus around their bases

issues.where: the near boulder at the right, x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%
issues.what: faceted planar faces with texture stretched and smeared along the bevelled edges
issues.fix: add geometric detail or displacement and re-project the texture so it does not stretch over the edges

issues.where: the ledge lips and cliff walls, x 42 to 58% and x 83 to 100%, y 25 to 42%
issues.what: rock looks like melted clay or plastic: soft rounded shapes, smeared streaky texture, a waxy sheen, one material everywhere
issues.fix: use sharper stratified rock with crisp fracture detail, rougher specular response and varied materials

issues.where: the fog inside the pit, x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%
issues.what: the fog is a flat grey tint with no volume, light shafts or density change, and the wall behind it shows through as smeared streaks
issues.fix: use volumetric fog with varied density and light scattering from the sky

issues.where: the far edge of the rock shelf against the water, x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%
issues.what: a bright halo outline runs along the rock silhouette, a compositing or depth-of-field edge artefact
issues.fix: fix the depth-of-field and matte edge so the defocused rock blends into the background with no rim

issues.where: where the water meets the rock shelf at the right
issues.what: the water is a flat grey plane with no depth, reflection or ripple and no wet edge, foam or crust where it meets the rock
issues.fix: add reflections of the cliffs and sky, surface variation and a darkened wet band and deposits at the shoreline

issues.where: the red plant fronds, x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%
issues.what: the fronds have a noisy stippled or dithered texture with grainy speckles in place of clean fibres
issues.fix: raise the sample count or anti-aliasing on the thin foliage and use proper alpha or fibre geometry

issues.where: the rock surface under the plants
issues.what: a soft, low-detail texture close to the camera, with little sign of light from the bright hazy sky on the ground
issues.fix: add higher-frequency surface detail and warmer sky fill on the near rock

issues.where: the far plain at the top left
issues.what: the distant animals are too small to check for eyes or ears, and their silhouettes read as stiff and similar
issues.fix: vary the poses and confirm in a closer crop that they have no eyes or ears
